correctness.rationale: On (0,∞)^2 with positive parameters and e>0, the printed F1=x[r/(1+s1y)−a(1+s2s1y/(1+s1y))−bx−(c+ey)y], F2=y[−n+ε(c+ey)x] has exact Dulac multiplier B=1/(xy). Independent symbolic differentiation confirms ∂x(BF1)+∂y(BF2)=εe−b/y, no omitted x-dependent terms. A nonconstant positive periodic trajectory is a simple closed curve and its Jordan interior remains in the positive quadrant (convex positivity); BF has zero outward flux along Γ. Green gives εe|D|=b∬_D y^(−1), hence harmonic mean b/(εe). A continuous strictly increasing divergence integrand with a sole zero y_H forces minΓ y<y_H<maxΓ y. At any positive equilibrium, substituting both equilibrium equations into the trace reduces it to xbar(εe ybar−b), independently verified symbolically. No finite simulation proves cycle existence; statement is necessary only.
residual_risks: Only cycles wholly in (0,∞)^2, positive e; identity does not prove existence, stability, number or bifurcation transversality.
